title: Symmetry of the correlated pair weight
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x,y$ be points of the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Under the joint distribution formed by choosing a uniform point and then independently retaining or flipping each coordinate with retention probability $(1+\rho)/2$, the probability assigned to the ordered pair $(x,y)$ is unchanged when $x$ and $y$ are interchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ and $y$ are points of the $n$-dimensional sign cube
